verse.verse_1: By the night as it envelops;
verse.verse_2: And by the day as it appears in brightness;
verse.verse_3: And by Him Who created male and female;
verse.verse_4: Certainly, your efforts and deeds are diverse (different in aims and purposes);
verse.verse_5: As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allah and fears Him,
verse.verse_7: We will make smooth for him the path of ease (goodness).
verse.verse_8: But he who is greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient.
verse.verse_9: And gives the lie to Al-Husna (see Verse No: 6 footnote);
verse.verse_10: We will make smooth for him the path for evil;
verse.verse_11: And what will his wealth benefit him when he goes down (in destruction).
verse.verse_12: Truly! Ours it is (to give) guidance,
verse.verse_13: And truly, unto Us (belong) the last (Hereafter) and the first (this world).
verse.verse_14: Therefore I have warned you of a Fire blazing fiercely (Hell);
verse.verse_15: None shall enter it save the most wretched,
verse.verse_17: And Al-Muttaqun (the pious and righteous - see V. 2:2) will be far removed from it (Hell).
verse.verse_18: He who spends his wealth for increase in self-purification,
verse.verse_19: And have in his mind no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
verse.verse_20: Except only the desire to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High;
verse.verse_21: He surely will be pleased (when he will enter Paradise).
